keyEvents.text: Goal! Slovakia 1, Faroe Islands 0. Erik Prekop (Slovakia) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Dávid Hancko with a cross.
Goal! Slovakia 1, Faroe Islands 1. Viljormur Davidsen (Faroe Islands) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Slovakia 1, Faroe Islands 1.
Second Half begins Slovakia 1, Faroe Islands 1.
Goal! Slovakia 1, Faroe Islands 2. Áki Samuelsen (Faroe Islands) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Petur Knudsen.
Martin Valjent (Slovakia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Petur Knudsen (Faroe Islands) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Slovakia. Ivan Mesík replaces Martin Valjent.
Substitution, Slovakia. Róbert Bozeník replaces Albert Rusnák.
Substitution, Faroe Islands. Poul Kallsberg replaces Áki Samuelsen.
Substitution, Faroe Islands. Jóannes Bjartalíd replaces Géza Turi.
Substitution, Faroe Islands. Adrian Justinussen replaces Hanus Sørensen.
Dominik Greif (Slovakia) is shown the yellow card.
Jóannes Danielsen (Faroe Islands) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Slovakia 2, Faroe Islands 2. Lukás Haraslín (Slovakia) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
